fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is selectable only after deleting its impossible claim of injectivity on the complete integer kernel: any map from a nonzero integer lattice to finitely many residue coordinates has a nonzero kernel, for example prime multiples. The valid bounded objective is separation of the recomputed enlarged Graver basis and every sub-17E malformed vector.

Proposal 1 does not justify that a perfect-hash family isolates signed movements; isolating a support cell prevents cancellation only with an explicitly nonzero calibrated tag there. A finite synthesis must verify this rather than assume it, and a pass would amend Q1 to vector-valued transfer while leaving Q2-Q5 open.

Proposal 2 is killed by its requirement that added linear rows agree on every legal fiber. Such rows annihilate the affine span of legal differences and therefore cannot remove a toric exchange lying in that span; network-matrix or SNF properties do not escape G13.

Proposal 3 lacks a complete emitted tile, exact Euclidean realization of its residue digits, and lift-independent sections. Higher jets merely move some dependencies upward, while finite quotients still have exact kernel elements and the carry/lumpability obstruction remains untouched.

Proposal 4 re-linearizes multiplication through unrestricted one-hot selectors, exposing it to the existing G19 signed-flow mechanism. No concrete state subset, matrices, energy, or finite enumeration bound is supplied, so its proposed two-step search is not implementable as written.

Proposal 5 only reanalyzes the already-killed 40-by-18 margin completion. Minkowski supplies a short transfer-kernel vector under conditional rank and determinant hypotheses, but does not prove malformedness, liftability through missing rows, or energy below 17E for an actual Q1 tile.

Proposal 6 gives no bounded Gram denominators, port-map family, center domain, Construction-A data, or gluing constraints. “Small rational” is not a finite experiment, and shell emptiness alone would not establish saturated NAND/COPY fibers.

Proposal 7 misuses Nullstellensatz for strict inequalities, positive definiteness, saturation, and universal kernel conditions. A certificate over the proposed bounded architecture would require explicit finite case splitting or a real Positivstellensatz formulation, and would not decide Q1 generally.
evidence: The current single-tag margin-only matrices are exactly falsified at E=18 by malformed energy 42<306 in every tested fiber. Proposal 1 genuinely changes that killed mechanism by adding residue dimensions rather than retesting the same completion.

Lean proves that one F289 symbol cannot separate three surviving independent directions, but it does not obstruct several direct-sum symbols. Thus r=2,3,4 synthesis is a real bounded discriminator at the Q1 frontier.

Existing verifier evidence covers only the hash-locked 18-variable margin completions; no maximal-order full tile exists. Any new pass must therefore serialize every added row, target, factor, orientation, DROP fiber, and resulting legal energy.

The G13 affine-span collision directly contradicts Proposal 2's legal-agreement constraint. The G19 and A5 counterexamples likewise show that emitted multiplication tables do not by themselves exclude signed virtual flows.
No finite local success may be promoted to valuation transfer, recursive growth, or an asymptotic GapCVP theorem; Q2 carry stabilization and Q3 cycle means remain completely unverified.
